guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit o1.exchange
guide.description: Go to the o1.exchange platform and click “Enter App” on the homepage.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Create Your Account
guide.description: Sign up using your email or connect a Solana wallet. Complete any profile setup steps before moving on.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund Your Wallet with SOL
guide.description: You need SOL to trade on the platform. Buy SOL from Binance and transfer it to your Solana wallet, or bridge assets from another network using the bridge widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade Across Multiple Token Mints
guide.description: The allocation formula rewards variety, not just volume. Trade different token pairs across the DEX rather than cycling through the same pair. Holding periods and retention on the platform are also factored in, so don’t just churn trades and leave.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Access the Rewards Section
guide.description: Find the rewards or referral section in the platform menu. Grab your unique referral link and track your S1.1 and S1.2 points from here.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Refer Active Traders
guide.description: Share your referral link with people who will actually use the platform. The formula rewards referral count, so quality referrals who trade consistently contribute more to your allocation than dormant signups.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Engage on X and Discord
guide.description: Social contributions count toward your $O allocation. Participate in o1.exchange’s Discord, pursue the Discord Maxi role if eligible, and engage with the project on X. These signals are part of the formula, not a bonus.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
